name: Chicken pushup
description: A chicken pushup is a pushup with the knees on the floor. Lower the chest to the floor, then press back up.

items.content: Knees on the floor, hands under the shoulders
Body in one straight line from head to knees
Shoulder blades move freely, no winging
Neck neutral, gaze slightly ahead of the hands

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Knees on the floor, chest to floor, elbows tucked, body straight from head to knees.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Knees on the floor, elbows locked, body straight from head to knees.
